post.summary: Creates a new media document from a base64-encoded file upload (`fileName` +
post.description:
Creates a new media document from a base64-encoded file upload (`fileName` +
`fileContent`). SVG files are accepted, as in the admin UI. Duplicate
uploads are accepted — there is no content-hash deduplication.

When `name` is omitted, it defaults to the uploaded file's base name, cut to
160 characters. `description` and `keywords` must not contain HTML markup
(681211).

Rejections: an unsupported extension (681001), a `mediaType` mismatch
(681002), content that does not match the extension (681003), an empty file
(681004), an invalid file name (681006).

Pass `dryRun=1` to validate the request and preview the result — including
the resolved `name` — without persisting anything to the database or disk.
A dry-run response always has `mediaID: null`.

parameters.name: apiVersion
parameters.description: API version to use. Defaults to the current version when omitted.

parameters.name: apiKey
parameters.description: The API Key used to authenticate the request.

mediaID.description: Numeric ID of the media document, or null on a dry run.

mediaTypeLabel.description: Human-readable label of the media type.

extension.description: File extension, lowercase, without the leading dot.

dateAdded.description: ISO 8601 timestamp, or null on a dry run.

authorID.description: User ID of the document's author (the API key's pseudo-user), or null on a dry run.

image.description: Image-specific details, or null for a non-image document or a dry run.

mediaDocument.description: The created (or, on a dry run, previewed) media document.

dryRun.description: Reflects the dryRun request parameter. When true, nothing was persisted.

403.description: Forbidden. The API key is not granted access to this method (error 183005) or the key's user lacks the required right (error 183006).

description.description: Free-text description of the media document. Must not contain HTML markup.

dryRun.description: If enabled, a dry run of the operation will be performed. The process will run as usual, but no actual changes will be made. Note: Any IDs and other data types returned will not correspond to real entities.

fileContent.description: Base64-encoded file content, optionally as a `data:<mime>;base64,` URI.

fileName.description: Name of the file being uploaded, including its extension (e.g. `hero.png`).

keywords.description: Comma-separated search keywords for the media document. Must not contain HTML markup.

mediaType.description: Optional media type constraint (e.g. Image, PDF). When given, the uploaded file's resolved type must match it exactly, letting consumers fail fast at upload rather than at content write.

name.description: Name of the media document. Defaults to the uploaded file's base name when not specified.

post.summary: Deletes a media document's database record and its underlying file.
post.description:
Deletes a media document's database record and its underlying file.
Returns the document's pre-deletion shape with `deleted: true`. Rejects an
unknown `mediaID` with HTTP 404 (681201).

There is no in-use guard: the framework has no concept of which other
records reference a media document, so deleting one still referenced
elsewhere is the caller's responsibility (see the Media API README).

Pass `dryRun=1` to preview the document that would be deleted without
actually deleting it. A dry run never calls the delete operation, since
deletion unlinks the file immediately and cannot be safely undone within a
preview.

post.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of media documents, newest first by default.
post.description:
Retrieves a paginated list of media documents, newest first by default.
Without parameters, returns at most 50 documents — never the whole table.
Supports free-text search (name, keywords, description), filtering by
media type and extension, and sorting. Content is never included in the
list; use `GetMediaDocument` with `includeContent=true` for a single
document's content.

parameters.name: apiVersion
parameters.description: API version to use. Defaults to the current version when omitted.

parameters.name: apiKey
parameters.description: The API Key used to authenticate the request.

parameters.name: extensions
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of file extensions to filter by (e.g. png, pdf).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Must be between 1 and 200. Defaults to 50 if not specified.

parameters.name: mediaTypes
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of media type IDs to filter by (e.g. Image, PDF).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based offset into the result set. Defaults to 0 if not specified.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Field to sort the results by. Defaults to dateAdded.

parameters.name: orderDir
parameters.description: Sort direction, asc or desc. Defaults to desc.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text search terms, matched against the document name, keywords and description. Terms are AND-combined by default; the AND/OR/NOT operators are supported.

mediaID.description: Numeric ID of the media document.

mediaTypeLabel.description: Human-readable label of the media type.

extension.description: File extension, lowercase, without the leading dot.

dateAdded.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the document was added.

authorID.description: User ID of the document's author.

image.description: Image-specific details, or null for a non-image document.

mediaDocuments.description: List of media documents matching the given filters.

limit.description: The maximum number of results returned.

offset.description: The zero-based offset applied to the result set.

totalCount.description: Total number of matching results, independent of paging.

post.summary: Updates the name, description and/or keywords of an existing media document,
post.description:
Updates the name, description and/or keywords of an existing media document,
and optionally replaces its file content (`fileName` + `fileContent`, sent
together or not at all). An empty `description` or `keywords` clears the
field; omitting a parameter leaves it unchanged.

At least one change must be submitted (681221). A replacement file must keep
the document's current extension (681005). The HTML rule, grant check and
unknown-ID handling are identical to the other media methods.

Pass `dryRun=1` to validate the request and preview the result without
persisting anything to the database or disk.

parameters.name: apiVersion
parameters.description: API version to use. Defaults to the current version when omitted.

parameters.name: apiKey
parameters.description: The API Key used to authenticate the request.

mediaID.description: Numeric ID of the media document.

mediaTypeLabel.description: Human-readable label of the media type.

extension.description: File extension, lowercase, without the leading dot.

dateAdded.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the document was originally added.

authorID.description: User ID of the document's original author.

image.description: Image-specific details, or null for a non-image document.

mediaDocument.description: The updated (or, on a dry run, previewed) media document.

modified.description: Whether the request actually changed anything.

dryRun.description: Reflects the dryRun request parameter. When true, nothing was persisted.

403.description: Forbidden. The API key is not granted access to this method (error 183005) or the key's user lacks the required right (error 183006).

description.description: Free-text description of the media document. Must not contain HTML markup.

dryRun.description: If enabled, a dry run of the operation will be performed. The process will run as usual, but no actual changes will be made. Note: Any IDs and other data types returned will not correspond to real entities.

fileContent.description: Base64-encoded file content, optionally as a `data:<mime>;base64,` URI.

fileName.description: Name of the file being uploaded, including its extension (e.g. `hero.png`).

keywords.description: Comma-separated search keywords for the media document. Must not contain HTML markup.

name.description: Name of the media document. Defaults to the uploaded file's base name when not specified.
